tagline: From inspiration to installation, we help people find their unique style and turn their home into a space for self-expression.
hero_kpi_rationale: Adjusted EBITDA margin reflects the company's ability to generate operating profitability before financial charges, which is the central pivot of the 'Platform Design' strategy aimed at improving margins through reduced complexity and operational excellence in a competitive market.

kpis.name: Net Sales
kpis.explanation: Total amount of product sales after deductions.
kpis.description: Net sales decreased by 7.5% for fiscal year 2025, impacted by lower in-store traffic and smaller projects, as well as a housing market affected by high mortgage rates.
kpis.signal: Decline in sales across primary channels.

kpis.name: Gross Profit
kpis.explanation: Profit realized after deducting direct production costs.
kpis.description: Gross profit decreased by 18.9% for fiscal year 2025, primarily due to lower volumes causing negative leverage on fixed costs and higher input costs.

kpis.name: Gross Margin %
kpis.explanation: Percentage of gross profit relative to net sales.
kpis.description: Gross margin as a percentage of sales decreased by 2.5 points to 17.9% in fiscal year 2025, primarily due to lower volumes and higher input costs.

kpis.name: Selling and marketing expenses
kpis.explanation: Costs associated with promoting and selling products.
kpis.description: Selling and marketing expenses decreased by 6.9% for fiscal year 2025, reflecting lower sales and controlled discretionary spending.
kpis.signal: Reduction in selling and marketing expenses.

kpis.name: General and administrative expenses
kpis.explanation: Costs related to the general management of the company.
kpis.description: General and administrative expenses decreased by 39.1% for fiscal year 2025, primarily due to the completion of amortization of intangible assets related to customer relationships and reduced incentive and profit-sharing costs.
kpis.signal: Significant reduction in general and administrative expenses.

kpis.name: Effective Income Tax Rate
kpis.explanation: Percentage of corporate income paid in taxes.
kpis.description: The effective income tax rate decreased from 23.5% to 21.4% for fiscal year 2025, due to favorable adjustments in uncertain tax positions and additional tax credits.
kpis.signal: Decrease in effective income tax rate.

kpis.name: Adjusted EBITDA margin
kpis.explanation: Measure of profitability before interest, taxes, depreciation, and amortization, adjusted for non-recurring items.
kpis.description: Adjusted EBITDA margin decreased by 1.5 points to 12.2% in fiscal year 2025, reflecting lower volumes and higher input costs.

kpis.name: Platform Design initiative
kpis.explanation: Strategy aimed at reducing complexity and improving operational efficiency to increase gross margins.
kpis.description: The 'Platform Design' strategy is a pillar of the company's 'GDP' (Growth, Digital Transformation, Platform Design) vision to improve profitability through reduced complexity and operational excellence, contributing to the recovery of EBITDA margins.

kpis.name: Digital Transformation
kpis.explanation: Initiatives aimed at improving processes and customer experience through technology.
kpis.description: Digital transformation is a key objective of the 'GDP' strategy to become 'One American Woodmark', strengthening processes and operational efficiency, notably through the deployment of a cloud-based ERP strategy.
kpis.signal: Investment in the 'One American Woodmark' strategy.

risks.title: Customer Concentration
risks.score_rationale: The company is highly dependent on two major customers, Home Depot and Lowe's, which represent approximately 40.8% of its net sales. The loss of one of these customers could have a significant negative impact on the company's financial results. This is mentioned in Item 1A, section 'Risks related to our business and industry'.

risks.title: Cost Volatility
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to fluctuations in raw material and energy costs, which can negatively impact its margins and financial results. This is mentioned in Item 1A, section 'Risks related to our business and industry'.

risks.title: Supply Chain Risks
risks.score_rationale: The company relies on its suppliers to obtain essential raw materials and components. Supply chain disruptions could negatively impact the company's operations and financial results. This is mentioned in Item 1A, section 'Risks related to our business and industry'.

risks.title: Increased Competition
risks.score_rationale: The company operates in a highly competitive market, with numerous manufacturers and distributors of similar products. Competition may reduce market share and financial performance. This is mentioned in Item 1A, section 'Risks related to our business and industry'.

risks.title: Geopolitical Risks
risks.score_rationale: The company manufactures its products in the United States and Mexico and sells them in the United States and Canada. It is exposed to geopolitical risks due to its limited international operations, including fluctuations in exchange rates and changes in trade policy. This is mentioned in Item 1A.

ai_positioning.summary: The company mentions investments in cybersecurity and a cloud ERP strategy, but does not indicate specific initiatives related to generative AI or its integration into its products or operations.
evidence: Increases in digital spending related to our cloud ERP strategy and cybersecurity preparedness.
